audit_type: independent AI semantic audit of supplied synthetic cases and certificates
method: Read every case source and every certificate comparison; independently bind target/property/population/conditions/time, assess quantities/units/derivations and coverage. Gate outputs counted only as structural results, never taken as semantic proof. Source and article anchor presence mechanically checked as supporting evidence.
interpretation: 47 blocked comparisons consist of 28 supported calendar/clock components with unrepresented units and 19 different-target comparisons. Of those 19, 10 have unequal same-unit values, 6 have equal same-unit values, and 3 have incompatible units. The 28 calendar/clock blocks are not successful false-numerical-conflict prevention. Equal-numeral distractors also do not demonstrate prevention of a numerical mismatch.
limits: AI audit, not formal semantic proof or external truth verification.
Generic axis language is interpreted jointly with the full source, article, quantity explanation and arithmetic, not as standalone proof.
Separating a population restriction from a measurement condition can be conventional; no classification ambiguity changes an audited eligibility result.
